description: MIRA Request — a unit of work the community can pick up (issue-tracker-shaped). Maps mira.yaml class Request (mixin NodeSchema). DRAFT.

main.description: A request. requestFor points at the Study being asked for; requestTarget at the Claim it concerns. Issue-tracker fields (status, assignee) are intentionally omitted — the schema does not yet define them (see SPEC.md open questions).

description.description: MIRA dgb:description — what is being requested.

attributedTo.description: MIRA creator, only when it differs from the signing repo DID.

requestFor.description: MIRA request_for — Studies this request asks for.

requestTarget.description: MIRA request_target — Claims this request targets.
